title: Billing Drying Equipment Days on Water Damage Mitigation Jobs
content:
Under this Water Damage Mitigation field billing standard, drying equipment is billed by the calendar day it runs, per unit and per equipment type.

## Standard
The job must be in drying or drying complete status when an equipment day is charged. Drying equipment is billed per unit per calendar day at the daily rate of the job's tier for that equipment type; a calendar day is billable when the unit was on site and running at any time that day, so the equipment set day and the removal day each count as a full day. One line is booked per equipment type per calendar day, with the quantity equal to the units of that type running that day. The first calendar days of equipment, up to the tier's billable drying day cap counted from the drying start date, are billable without further support. A calendar day beyond the cap is billable only when a monitoring visit is recorded on the job for that same calendar day; a day beyond the cap with no monitoring visit is not billed for any equipment type. On tiers that require an air scrubber, the air scrubber runs for the whole drying period and is billed on every billable day. Equipment days after the drying complete date are never billed.

## Line amount
Each equipment day line is the quantity of units multiplied by the tier's daily rate for that equipment type, rounded to the cent, half up.

## Counting the days (hypothetical: drying start on the 10th, a cap of 5 days, removal on the 17th)
| Calendar day | Within the cap? | Monitoring visit recorded that day | Billable? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10th (set day) | yes, day 1 | not needed | yes, as a full day |
| 11th to 14th | yes, days 2 to 5 | not needed | yes |
| 15th | no | yes | yes, for every equipment type running |
| 16th | no | no | no, for any equipment type |
| 17th (removal day) | no | yes | yes, as a full day |
| 18th | after the drying complete date | — | never |

## Notes
- The number of billed drying days on a job is the count of distinct calendar days that carry an equipment day line.
- Three air movers and one dehumidifier running on one day produce two lines for that day: one air mover line with a quantity of 3 and one dehumidifier line with a quantity of 1.
